seat.BEST_WHY: The timber rail along the north wall (y≈420–450) is built from blocks of unequal length and value, with a driven pin at x≈340 that has three washer marks down its shaft and a smaller bracket at x≈460, so the rail reads as repaired rather than tiled. The three crossed-timber obstacles at lower left (x 180–300, y 650–720) sit correctly in the falloff: their upper timbers keep a highlight edge, the lower timbers go to near-black, and they are in the same dark brown as the rail, so the props and the architecture belong to the same people. The A-frame brace straddling the rail at (510–560, 395–450) is a straight piece of shoring with no decoration, which is exactly what the fiction asks for. The crack beside the figure (from ≈(240,470) to ≈(430,600)) has kinks and changes width, and the floor hatching inside each tile differs tile to tile.
seat.WORST_WHY: There is no light falloff anywhere: the orc at (215–235, 0–25) is supposed to be the only light, yet the bottom-left grey floor and the far right edge are as bright as the ground at the figure's feet. The pond at (250–335, 0–190) is a hard-edged rectangle meeting dirt with no bank, wet rim or broken edge tile. The dirt texture's rust veins repeat on a 32px period (visible at (100–230, 20–120)). The same moss stamp appears at (20–45, 50–85) on the left floor and again at (345–375, 5–30) right of the pond. The crates at (62–97, 0–90) are drawn in 3/4 view with a slatted front while the barrels at (115–190, 190–215) are pure top-down circles, so the props do not share a projection.

panel.ruling: five seats; block only on strong-majority regression (>=4 of 5 rank below the reference); else install if exit met and plant caught. Rank-in-deck cannot resolve polish-sized deltas at a 40% flip rate. — Rafe, 2026-09-09
panel.law: a gate's binding term must have a measured noise floor and must never be a single sample. — Rafe, 2026-09-08

_what: THE ITEM'S OWN MEASURED EXIT — required by INSTALL-LATEST (Rafe, 2026-09-08).
A build installs because it DID THE THING IT SET OUT TO DO. The rank test only says
the doing cost nothing against the seeded reference; this says what was done. Without
it, 'not worse than the reference' would mean 'not different from it', and a round
that changed nothing would install as readily as one that fixed something.
Declared here per item, recorded into the verdict, re-checked at the gate. The gate
refuses a `met` with no measurement behind it.
